[[File:EchoBaseDeckOfficer-TESB.png|thumb|right|250px|Deck officer Tamizander Rey]]
{{Quote|Deck officer! ''Deck officer!''|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], shouting to [[Tamizander Rey]] in [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]]|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
A '''deck officer''', also known as '''Flight Deck Officer'''<ref name="DP">{{JournalCite|14|Special Ops: Drop Points}}</ref> was a [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]] bestowed upon [[Starship/Legends|starship]] crewmembers, usually [[Officer/Legends|officers]], who frequented the deck of the starship, but held no responsibility for running that vessel's operations.

==History==
{{Quote|Excuse me. Can you tell me where I can find the deck officer?|[[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], to a desk officer|<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>}}
[[CT-327/Legends|CT-327]] was the deck officer of the [[Rishi Station/Legends|Rishi Station]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He died during the [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|Battle of the Rishi moon]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

An [[Unidentified Imperial deck officer (Helmsman)|unnamed crewman]] held this rank aboard [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mils Giel|Giel's]] [[Helmsman (battlecruiser)|flagship]].

[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Bendlar Kovings]] served as the Flight Deck Officer for [[Drop Point: Gelgelar]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="DP" />
